hooks.command: python -c "import subprocess,json,sys; r=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--name-only','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,errors='ignore'); u=subprocess.run(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],capture_output=True,text=True,errors='ignore'); files=[f for f in (r.stdout+u.stdout).strip().splitlines() if f and f!='CLAUDE.md']; sys.stdout.write(json.dumps({'systemMessage':'[CLAUDE.md update needed] Changes: '+', '.join(files[:4])+('...' if len(files)>4 else '')})) if files else None"
